author: ExoaRu
body:
Hi, so today I was playing. And this is really the only clip I have of Pepe in the act. I will be looking out with FRAPS at the ready to catch him again. I believe he uses aimbot and if you look in the video, as he is falling his head snaps to me and tags me about 3-4 times. Sorry about my voice in the video, just replay it over and over again so you can see him locking on to me. I will get another video in here shortly (I am from a far but you can see how accurate his pvp skills are)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_Wj109AtyJc&feature=youtu.be (1) - him falling and hitting me.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZQFcyBBV0yw&feature=youtu.be (2) -look in the top right hand corner to see him flailing like an accurate pvp fish.
I know I should have used 'you know you got that thing' since it's pretty clear he has them hacks; thanks for your time.

replies.body:
Hello dolan,

After watching the evidence carefully and following your indications, I don't think the player is hacking; at least from the evidence that you have provided. Please next time that you spectate a supposed hacker, do /leave and spec him in third person mode. Feel free to create another report if you gather more evidence of the player.

Regards,

javipepe - Avicus Network Developer, Moderator and Referee
